environment.description: Same Spring Boot application on ECS Fargate. Task definition specifies linuxParameters with capabilities dropped: CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN removed via 'drop' list. Container runs as non-root uid 1000 via 'user' field. The task execution role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/DenyRCEEscalation) that denies iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, and all EC2/ECS control-plane actions. A VPC endpoint policy on the S3 gateway endpoint restricts access to only the reporting-output bucket. The container has a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounted at /tmp only. Security group restricts inbound to ALB security group only (sg-0abc123).

config.network_acl: deny all outbound except 443 to S3 prefix list and 443 to CloudWatch prefix list
